input: Sign my kid up for a chess tournament

gold.taskTitle: Sign My Kid Up for a Chess Tournament
gold.taskDescription: Register the user's child for an upcoming chess tournament.

questions.title: How old is your child?
questions.description: The child's age helps identify age-appropriate tournament divisions and eligibility requirements.

questions.title: What is your child's current chess skill level?
questions.description: Knowing whether the child is a beginner, intermediate, or advanced player helps narrow down suitable tournaments.

questions.title: Does your child have an official chess rating?
questions.description: Many tournaments require or use a USCF, FIDE, or school rating to place players in the correct section.

questions.title: What city or region should the tournament be in?
questions.description: Location helps filter tournaments that are realistically accessible for the family.

questions.title: Do you have a specific date or timeframe in mind?
questions.description: A target date or date range helps identify which upcoming tournaments are viable options.

questions.title: Is this a school, local club, or open public tournament?
questions.description: The type of tournament determines where to search and what registration process to follow.

questions.title: Is there a registration fee budget you want to stay within?
questions.description: Entry fees vary widely between tournaments, so knowing a budget helps filter appropriate options.
